vsm2.17:221.1: Saṅkhepena hi saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphassoti
vsm2.17:221.2: ime cakkhusamphassādayo cha eva phassā bhavanti.
vsm2.17:221.3: Vitthārena pana cakkhusamphassādayo pañca kusalavipākā, pañca akusalavipākāti dasa,
vsm2.17:221.5: evaṃ sabbepi saṅkhārapaccayā vuttaviññāṇamiva bāttiṃsa honti.
vsm2.17:222.1: Yaṃ panetassa bāttiṃsavidhassāpi phassassa paccayo saḷāyatanaṃ, tattha,
vsm2.17:222.2:
Chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ, cakkhādiṃ bāhirehipi;
Saḷāyatanamicchanti, chahi saddhiṃ vicakkhaṇā.
vsm2.17:223.4: aññattha sabbasaṅgahato saḷāyatanañca phassassa paccayoti ekadesasarūpekasesaṃ katvā
vsm2.17:223.5: chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ cakkhādiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
vsm2.17:223.6: Tañhi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatanantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm2.17:223.9: te yaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ phassassa paccayo hoti, taṃ sabbampi dīpentā bāhirampi pariggahetvā
vsm2.17:223.10: tadeva chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ bāhirehipi rūpāyatanādīhi saddhiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
vsm2.17:223.11: Tampi hi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatananti etesaṃ ekasese kate
vsm2.17:224.1: Etthāha – na sabbāyatanehi eko phasso sambhoti, nāpi ekamhā āyatanā sabbe phassā,
vsm2.17:224.2: ayañca saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti ekova vutto, so kasmāti.
vsm2.17:225.1: Tatridaṃ vissajjanaṃ – saccametaṃ, sabbehi eko, ekamhā vā sabbe na sambhonti,
vsm2.17:225.3: Yathā cakkhusamphasso cakkhāyatanā rūpāyatanā cakkhuviññāṇasaṅkhātā manāyatanā avasesasampayuttadhammāyatanā cāti
vsm2.17:225.6:
Ekopanekāyatanappabhavo iti dīpito;
Phassoyaṃ ekavacananiddesenīdha tādinā.
vsm2.17:225.8: anekehi āyatanehi eko phasso hotīti tādinā dīpitoti attho.
vsm2.17:226.2:
Chadhā pañca tato ekaṃ, navadhā bāhirāni cha;
Yathāsambhavametassa, paccayatte vibhāvaye.
vsm2.17:227.2: cakkhusamphassādibhedato pañcavidhassa phassassa nissayapurejātindriyavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chadhā paccayā honti.
vsm2.17:227.8: Manosamphassassa pana tāni ca dhammāyatanañca tathā ca ārammaṇapaccayamatteneva cāti
vsm2.17:227.9: evaṃ bāhirāni cha yathāsambhavametassa paccayatte vibhāvayeti.
vsm2.17:229.1: Etassapi padassa vibhaṅge ‘‘cakkhusamphassajā vedanā. Sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāya… manosamphassajā vedanā’’ti (vibha. 231) evaṃ dvārato saḷeva vedanā vuttā,
vsm2.17:229.2: tā pana pabhedena ekūnanavutiyā cittehi sampayuttattā ekūnanavuti matā.
vsm2.17:230.1:
Vedanāsu panetāsu, idha bāttiṃsa vedanā;
Vipākacittayuttāva, adhippetāti bhāsitā.
vsm2.17:230.2:
Aṭṭhadhā tattha pañcannaṃ, pañcadvāramhi paccayo;
Sesānaṃ ekadhā phasso, manodvārepi so tathā.
vsm2.17:231.1: Tattha hi pañcadvāre cakkhupasādādivatthukānaṃ pañcannaṃ vedanānaṃ cakkhusamphassādiko phasso
vsm2.17:231.3: Sesānaṃ pana ekekasmiṃ dvāre sampaṭicchanasantīraṇatadārammaṇavasena pavattānaṃ kāmāvacaravipākavedanānaṃ so cakkhusamphassādiko phasso
vsm2.17:232.1: Manodvārepi so tathāti manodvārepi hi tadārammaṇavasena pavattānaṃ kāmāvacaravipākavedanānaṃ so sahajātamanosamphassasaṅkhāto phasso
vsm2.17:232.4: Yā pana tā manodvāre tadārammaṇavasena pavattā kāmāvacaravedanā, tāsaṃ manodvārāvajjanasampayutto manosamphasso
vsm2.17:234.1: Imasmiṃ hi pade seṭṭhiputto brāhmaṇaputtoti pitito nāmavasena putto viya
vsm2.17:234.2: ‘‘rūpataṇhā. Sadda… gandha… rasa… phoṭṭhabba… dhammataṇhā’’ti (vibha. 232) ārammaṇato nāmavasena vibhaṅge cha taṇhā dīpitā.
vsm2.17:234.3: Tāsu pana taṇhāsu ekekā taṇhā pavattiākārato
vsm2.17:234.4: kāmataṇhā, bhavataṇhā, vibhavataṇhāti evaṃ tividhā matā.
vsm2.17:235.1: Rūpataṇhāyeva hi yadā cakkhussa āpāthamāgataṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ kāmassādavasena assādayamānā pavattati,
vsm2.17:235.3: Yadā tadevārammaṇaṃ ‘‘dhuvaṃ sassata’’nti pavattāya sassatadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ pavattati, tadā bhavataṇhā nāma hoti.
vsm2.17:235.5: Yadā pana tadevārammaṇaṃ ‘‘ucchijjati vinassatī’’ti pavattāya ucchedadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ pavattati, tadā vibhavataṇhā nāma hoti.
vsm2.17:235.9: Tā ajjhattarūpādīsu aṭṭhārasa, bahiddhā aṭṭhārasāti chattiṃsa.
vsm2.17:235.10: Iti atītā chattiṃsa, anāgatā chattiṃsa, paccuppannā chattiṃsāti aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhā honti.
vsm2.17:235.12: kāmataṇhādivasena vā tissova taṇhā hontīti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:236.1: Yasmā panime sattā puttaṃ assādetvā putte mamattena dhātiyā viya rūpādiārammaṇavasena uppajjamānaṃ vedanaṃ assādetvā vedanāya mamattena rūpādiārammaṇadāyakānaṃ cittakāra-gandhabba-gandhika-sūda-tantavāyarasāyanavidhāyakavejjādīnaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karonti.
vsm2.17:236.2: Tasmā sabbāpesā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā hotīti veditabbā.
vsm2.17:237.1:
Yasmā cettha adhippetā, vipākasukhavedanā;
Ekāva ekadhāvesā, tasmā taṇhāya paccayo.
vsm2.17:238.2:
Taṇhāya paccayā tasmā, honti tissopi vedanā;
Vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, iti vuttā mahesinā.
vsm2.17:238.3:
Vedanāpaccayā cāpi, yasmā nānusayaṃ vinā;
Hoti tasmā na sā hoti, brāhmaṇassa vusīmatoti.
vsm2.17:240.1: Tatrāyaṃ vibhāvanā – kāmupādānaṃ, diṭṭhupādānaṃ, sīlabbatupādānaṃ, attavādupādānanti imāni tāvettha cattāri upādānāni.
vsm2.17:241.1: Tesaṃ ayaṃ atthavibhāgo – vatthusaṅkhātaṃ kāmaṃ upādiyatīti kāmupādānaṃ,
vsm2.17:241.5: Tathā diṭṭhi ca sā upādānañcāti diṭṭhupādānaṃ.
vsm2.17:241.7: ‘‘Sassato attā ca loko cā’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 1.31) hi purimadiṭṭhiṃ uttaradiṭṭhi upādiyati.
vsm2.17:241.10: Gosīlagovatādīni hi ‘‘evaṃ suddhī’’ti abhinivesato sayameva upādānāni.
vsm2.17:241.11: Tathā vadanti etenāti vādo. Upādiyanti etenāti upādānaṃ.
vsm2.17:241.14: Attavādamattameva vā attāti upādiyanti etenāti attavādupādānaṃ.
vsm2.17:242.1: Dhammasaṅkhepavitthāre pana kāmupādānaṃ tāva ‘‘tattha katamaṃ kāmupādānaṃ?
vsm2.17:242.2: Yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmataṇhā kāmasneho kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ, idaṃ vuccati kāmupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1220; vibha. 938) āgatattā saṅkhepato taṇhādaḷhattaṃ vuccati.
vsm2.17:242.4: Keci panāhu ‘‘appattavisayapatthanā taṇhā andhakāre corassa hatthappasāraṇaṃ viya,
vsm2.17:242.6: Appicchatāsantuṭṭhitāpaṭipakkhā ca te dhammā. Tathā pariyesanārakkhadukkhamūlā’’ti.
vsm2.17:243.1: Vitthārato pana pubbe rūpādīsu vuttaaṭṭhasatappabhedāyapi taṇhāya daḷhabhāvo kāmupādānaṃ.
vsm2.17:243.3: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamaṃ diṭṭhupādānaṃ? Natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ…pe… sacchikatvā pavedentīti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi…pe… vipariyesaggāho. Idaṃ vuccati diṭṭhupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1221; vibha. 938).
vsm2.17:243.5: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamaṃ sīlabbatupādānaṃ? Sīlena suddhi, vatena suddhi, sīlabbatena suddhīti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi…pe… vipariyesaggāho. Idaṃ vuccati sīlabbatupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1222; vibha. 938).
vsm2.17:243.7: Yathāha – ‘‘tattha katamaṃ attavādupādānaṃ? Idha assutavā puthujjano…pe… sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati…pe… vipariyesaggāho, idaṃ vuccati attavādupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1223; vibha. 938).
vsm2.17:244.1: Kamatoti ettha pana tividho kamo uppattikkamo pahānakkamo desanākkamo ca.
vsm2.17:244.2: Tattha anamatagge saṃsāre imassa paṭhamaṃ uppattīti abhāvato kilesānaṃ nippariyāyena uppattikkamo na vuccati.
vsm2.17:244.3: Pariyāyena pana yebhuyyena ekasmiṃ bhave attaggāhapubbaṅgamo sassatucchedābhiniveso,
vsm2.17:244.4: tato ‘‘sassato ayaṃ attā’’ti gaṇhato attavisuddhatthaṃ sīlabbatupādānaṃ,
vsm2.17:244.5: ‘‘ucchijjatī’’ti gaṇhato paralokanirapekkhassa kāmupādānanti evaṃ paṭhamaṃ attavādupādānaṃ,
vsm2.17:244.6: tato diṭṭhisīlabbatakāmupādānānīti ayametesaṃ ekasmiṃ bhave uppattikkamo.
vsm2.17:246.1: Mahāvisayattā pana pākaṭattā ca etesu kāmupādānaṃ paṭhamaṃ desitaṃ.
vsm2.17:246.2: Mahāvisayaṃ hi taṃ aṭṭhacittasampayogā, appavisayāni itarāni catucittasampayogā,
vsm2.17:246.3: yebhuyyena ca ālayarāmattā pajāya pākaṭaṃ kāmupādānaṃ, na itarāni.
vsm2.17:246.4: Kāmupādāna vā kāmānaṃ samadhigamatthaṃ kotūhalamaṅgalādibahulo hoti,
vsm2.17:246.7: Tasmiṃ dvaye gokiriyaṃ kukkurakiriyaṃ vā disvāpi veditabbato oḷārikanti sīlabbatupādānaṃ paṭhamaṃ desitaṃ.
vsm2.17:247.1:
Taṇhā ca purimassettha, ekadhā hoti paccayo;
Sattadhā aṭṭhadhā vāpi, hoti sesattayassa sā.
vsm2.17:248.1: Ettha ca evaṃ desite upādānacatukke purimassa kāmupādānassa kāmataṇhā upanissayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti,
vsm2.17:248.4: upanissayena saha aṭṭhadhā vāpi paccayo hoti.
vsm2.17:248.5: Yadā ca sā upanissayavasena paccayo hoti, tadā asahajātāva hotīti.
